terms.comment: Our description, a board for keeping heat in: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for an insulation board. Tabula, tabulae f. is a broad noun for a single panel; the material is named separately.

Our formation for a board of expanded polystyrene, built on the classical spūmeus, spūmea, spūmeum, foaming, frothy (Verg., Ov., in Lewis & Short); no reference work has a word for the material. Glossed in Latin: tabula levissima ex māteriā artificiōsā spūmeā facta, quae parietibus forīs affīgitur, ut domus hieme calōrem retineat et aestāte frīgus.

phrases.english: Don’t make holes in this board.

sources: Lewis & Short: tabula · Lewis & Short: calor · Lewis & Short: perforo · Lewis & Short: spumeus
